prompt: Add a notification bell icon to the header showing recent job completions in a dropdown.
assertions: The dropdown includes a designed empty state (e.g. "no notifications yet") rather than rendering nothing or a blank list when there's no data
The dropdown/menu uses shadow-based elevation (.nova-card pattern) consistent with the rest of the app
Interactive elements (bell trigger, dropdown items) have visible focus states or aria attributes for keyboard/screen-reader accessibility
No new hardcoded hex color values are introduced outside src/lib/design-tokens.ts or globals.css
Reuses existing shared primitives/tokens rather than inventing one-off styling for the same job
